video_title: Has Dylan Harper earned the starting job over De’Aaron Fox? 👀 + Spurs offseason outlook | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama reflects on the biggest learning moment of his career
quotes.excerpt: This is the biggest lesson of my life, the biggest learning moment.
quotes.quote: This is the biggest lesson of my life, the biggest learning moment. I cannot tell exactly what the lesson is, but we are learning from that. What I am pissed about is that there is probably 100 games before we can be back in Finals. So, I do not know how to say it in English, but I am going to have to hold that inside of me and slow down and wait and execute for 100 games.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst discusses Victor Wembanyama's need for development and improvement
quotes.excerpt: He recognizes that he is not a complete player.
quotes.quote: He really took a lot of ownership and responsibility that he needed to improve. There were some answers that he gave in French that when you saw the translation, really echoed that and got more into it where he said about how much he has to focus on developing his game. He recognizes that he is not a complete player.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Bobby Marks projects Victor Wembanyama's upcoming rookie max extension
quotes.excerpt: Victor Wembanyama will likely sign a $250 million rookie max extension this offseason.
quotes.quote: All five starters are under contract, including Victor Wembanyama, who will likely sign a $250 million rookie max extension this offseason. Their top four core players off the bench, including Dylan Harper, are also back. Because they have so many players on these rookie-scale contracts, they have the flexibility to go out and do some free agency shopping.

quotes.speaker: Danny Manning
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Manning on the Spurs' roster depth and potential big man target
quotes.excerpt: They should go out and try to look for another big man.
quotes.quote: I do not see a guy like Dylan Harper saying, 'I need to start right away.' You have that three-headed monster, that is a good problem to have. You have Manu Ginobili there who can mentor Dylan Harper. It does not matter who starts, it matters who finishes. For me, I think they should go out and try to look for another big man. I am looking at a guy like Robert Williams from the Portland Trail Blazers who could be a target.
